artifact_delivered: RL Trading Agent — Q-learning on financial data, beat buy-and-hold on TSLA by 75.8 percentage points
workstream_summary: C534: Applied RL toolkit (C527-C533) to real financial problem. Built bin/rl_trading.py — Q-learning agent with discretized features (1d/5d returns, 10d vol, 14d RSI, position status) learning buy/hold/sell policy from OHLCV data. On TSLA (100 episodes): 153.7% return vs 78% buy-and-hold, Sharpe 1.21 vs 0.70. On SPY (30 episodes): 35.3% vs 64% — agent learns conservative policy in low-vol regime. Key insight: exploration budget must scale with asset volatility. Tabular Q-learning finds signal but needs sufficient state coverage.
